phenotypicFeatures.description: steppage gait with foot drop and pes cavus for both feet
tendon hyperreflexia in bilateral knee reflex and ankle reflex
mild involuntary movement in the neck, shoulders, and upper limbs
moderate slowness in performing rapid alternating movements in the right hand
dystonia and myoclonus-like movements (for limbs and trunk, but obvious for the right upper limb)
tests of coordinate movements (finger-nose test and heel-to-knee test) were impaired
felt very itchy when given squeezing to the Achilles tendon and gastrocnemius muscle
